Hi Dan / AWS team —

- Full demo (customer-facing): Tue Jun 16, 10:00–11:00 PT / 13:00–14:00 ET
- Preflight (internal + partners): Mon Jun 15, 09:30–09:50 PT / 12:30–12:50 ET

Attachments: preflight_checklist.pdf (very small — checklist + AV notes).

Ask: can you confirm whether Dan (CloudWave SI) can do the preflight window above, and whether AWS will provide an SA for the product demo segment (20m)? Also please share preferred attendee list for both slots so we can finalize calendar invites and a short runbook.
